name: Query Eligible Products
url: {{_endpoint}}/services/data/v{{version}}/query/?q=SELECT Product2.Name, ProductSellingModelId, Product2.Id FROM ProductSellingModelOption Group By Product2.Name, Product2.Id, ProductSellingModelId
description:
This query returns all the products that have a related Product Selling Model Option. To price a product with Subscription Management, the product must have a related Product Selling Model Option.

For more information, see [Set Up Products and Pricing in Subscription Management](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.subscription_mgmt_products_and_pricing_setup.htm).

query.value: SELECT Product2.Name, ProductSellingModelId, Product2.Id FROM ProductSellingModelOption Group By Product2.Name, Product2.Id, ProductSellingModelId
